title: Steel Wire Brush Heads for Trimmer – Heavy-Duty Weed & Moss Removers
descriptionHtml:
The line doesn't bite on tough weeds and moss?

Regular trimmer line just bounces off thick weeds, moss in joints and overgrown edges. You go back and forth with no result while the line wears down at record speed.

Clear the tough stuff – in one go

The steel wire heads tear tough weeds, moss and algae out of joints, edges and hard-to-reach areas that regular line can't handle. Put it on, go – and let the steel do the heavy lifting.

Features

  • Heavy-duty steel wire – handles tough weeds, moss and algae.
  • Multipack – lasts the whole season.
  • Compatible with most string trimmers.
  • Perfect for joints, edges and driveways.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
